source_analysis.alignment_method: median best lag in first seven during-TX windows; apply unchanged to last eight and both TX-off controls
source_analysis.interpretation: exploratory source-specific RF link evidence, not model accuracy or independent RF admission

source_receipt.spectral_snr_scope: parent 65535 samples; not AWGN SNR or exact selected-window SNR

preparation.method: tone CFO; source 99% band; first-seven-window scalar fit; fixed eighth-window inference
preparation.residual_interpretation: noise plus interference plus model mismatch; not calibrated SNR

posthoc_phase_diagnostic.method: posthoc source-referenced phase rate; first seven windows only

radio_snapshot_storage: All four identical raw before/after snapshots are represented by final_radio_state plus their hashes; original link-summary file hashes retained.
